findings.title: 工具卡摘要截断拆开 Unicode 代理对
findings.evidenceLevel: Actual production pure helper with valid Unicode input and real positive card limits; UI consumption source-only
findings.trigger: Valid supplementary Unicode character straddles max-1 UTF-16 boundary at existing 70/80/90 card limits
findings.expected: Truncated summaries remain well-formed Unicode text
findings.actual: Returned text contains a lone high surrogate; standard UTF-8 roundtrip yields U+FFFD
findings.controls: Short Unicode, complete emoji boundary, ASCII and BMP truncation
findings.limitations: No UI mount, Electron, actual tool execution or file open; raw arguments remain intact
relatedHistory: HL-02: Host GitHub selection label implementation
